metadata.title: Morok Achar | Manipuri Style Green Chilli Pickle
metadata.description:
This easy to make delicious Manipuri style green chilli pickle is a good side for any kind of meal. 

Also, this pickle can liven up any bland food by adding a fiery and sharp pungent taste to your palate. 

The best part about the pickle is that it is easy to prepare, as it can be made in 15 minutes and can be stored for a week.
